title: AI agents with separate knowledge for each brokerage brand

facts: Post: AI Agent and Automation Developer for several Canadian business brokerage brands; OpenAI/ChatGPT, n8n, Make.com.
Post asks for separate knowledge bases and instructions per brand, Search Console, Analytics and Google Ads analysis, Gmail/Drive/Calendar, lead follow-up, and approval before important actions.
Post starts with a small paid pilot. No client name or contact name in the post; personalization omitted.

opp.query: how to value a small business ontario
opp.change: Add a valuation FAQ section and a link from the sellers guide

cover.beat: Here's one AI setup running marketing for each of your brokerage brands, with its own knowledge and an approval step before anything changes.

scenes.beat: A weekly SEO request comes in tagged for {{brand.short}}. The brand tag picks that brand's knowledge base and your existing ChatGPT instructions, so the agent never mixes one brand with another. Its suggestions then wait for {{owner.name}} to approve.
